summary: Reading a subject's actual-state cache key seeks each claim kind instead of reading every claim the subject has, which had made each roster, terminal, now and refresh read grow with that history

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change; the query uses the existing subject and kind index.

compatibility.detail: The key names the same newest actual-state claim, so the cached value and when it is recomputed are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores the previous key query; nothing is stored.
